scope: Louisiana Field Conditions Explorer. Question: how have river and weather conditions changed around candidate carp-removal locations, and which need operational review today? Eight demonstration locations (SMML1 Simmesport, KRZL1 Krotz Springs, BLRL1 Butte La Rose, MCGL1 Morgan City (Atchafalaya), BTRL1 Baton Rouge, AEXL1 Alexandria, MLUL1 Monroe, BXAL1 Bogalusa); L'CARP works only in the Atchafalaya Basin and targets silver, bighead, grass and black carp. The feeds describe conditions only: no carp abundance, catch, legal access or trip safety.

newTools.name: site_status
newTools.purpose: Per-site operational review status for the carp locations: needs review flag with each reason (rule id, value, threshold, evidence ids), flood category now and at forecast peak, low water flag, and per-feed freshness (green <= 2 h, amber <= 6 h, red older; forecast stale after 36 h). Accepts asOf to recompute from data known at that time.
newTools.input: { sites?: string[] (lid or name; default all eight), asOf?: RFC 3339 (knowledge time; default now) }
newTools.output: rows of { site, name, basin, needsReview, reasons: [{ rule, value, threshold, evidenceIds }], categoryNow, categoryPeak, lowWater, feeds: { usgs, nwps, nws: { state, newestAt, ageHours } } }

newTools.name: river_readings
newTools.purpose: Observed stage and discharge series per site from USGS (15 min) and NWPS observed (hourly), each labelled with source and unit, plus window summary (latest, min, max, net change, 24 h mean for tidal MCGL1) and the known datum offset note (KRZL1).
newTools.input: { sites?: string[], from?: RFC 3339, to?: RFC 3339, hours?: number (default 24), params?: ('stage' | 'discharge')[], source?: 'usgs' | 'nwps' | 'both' }
newTools.output: rows of { site, source, param, unit, latest: { value, at }, change, min, max, mean24h?, notMeasured?: boolean, datumNote? }

newTools.name: river_forecast
newTools.purpose: NWPS river forecast issuances per site, bitemporal: the issuance current at asOf (or a named issuance), its valid range, 6 hour points, peak and peak flood category, the site's NWPS thresholds (-9999 treated as missing), horizon, and provenance (nwps-live or iem-archive). Can return the previous issuance for revision comparisons.
newTools.input: { sites?: string[], asOf?: RFC 3339 (knowledge time; default now), issuedAt?: RFC 3339, previous?: number (also return N earlier issuances) }
newTools.output: rows of { site, issuedAt, provenance, validFrom, validTo, points: [{ at, stageFt, flowKcfs? }], peak: { at, stageFt, category }, thresholds: { action, minor, moderate, major }, stale: boolean }

newTools.name: forecast_verify
newTools.purpose: Score one past issuance against NWPS observed stage at its valid times: paired points, error per point, mean absolute error, max miss, and how many valid times have not happened yet.
newTools.input: { sites?: string[], issuedAt?: RFC 3339, daysAgo?: number }
newTools.output: rows of { site, issuedAt, pairs: [{ at, forecastFt, observedFt, errorFt }], meanAbsErrorFt, maxErrorFt, pending }

newTools.name: review_history
newTools.purpose: Transitions of one site's needs review status over a window, with the time of each flip and the rule and evidence that caused it.
newTools.input: { site: string, from?: RFC 3339, to?: RFC 3339 (default last 7 days) }
newTools.output: { site, transitions: [{ at, from, to, rules: [{ rule, value, threshold, evidenceIds }] }] }

newTools.name: weather_forecast
newTools.purpose: NWS gridpoint forecast periods for a site or point (api.weather.gov), with the office updateTime used for freshness.
newTools.input: { site?: string (carp location id or name), lat?: number, lon?: number, periods?: number (default 6) }
newTools.output: { office, grid, updateTime, periods: [{ name, start, end, temperatureF, windSpeed, windDirection, precipProbability, shortForecast }] }

newTools.name: source_info
newTools.purpose: Static facts about one feed of the active app: publisher, API URL, human page, licence and attribution text, cadence, typical latency, rate limit, coverage limits, and what the feed can and cannot tell us. Read from the app config, no network call.
newTools.input: { feed: string (a feed id of the active app, e.g. usgs, nwps, crw) } or {} for all feeds
newTools.output: rows of { feed, publisher, apiUrl, pageUrl, licence, attribution, cadence, latency, rateLimit, coverage, limits[] }

newTools.name: evidence
newTools.purpose: Fetch one cited record by evidence id (wraps GraphQL `evidence(id)`): the record, its source API URL, publisher page, fetch time, ingest lag, feed state and links such as duplicateOf or the forecast issuance it belongs to.
newTools.input: { id: string (C14 evidence id, e.g. reading:..., sighting:..., forecast:...) }
newTools.output: { id, kind, record, sourceUrl, sourcePageUrl, fetchedAt, ingestLagSeconds, feed, links[] }

newTools.name: team_board
newTools.purpose: Read the active app's team board (GraphQL `board(id: "<app>:main")`): missions with their sites or areas and dates, and committed messages with author, recipient, thread and time. Human records, not a data feed.
newTools.input: { kind?: 'missions' | 'messages' | 'all', about?: string (place, site or area name), hours?: number (default 168) }
newTools.output: { missions: [{ id, title, place, bbox, start, end, assignees }], messages: [{ id, from, to, thread, at, body }] }

toolChanges.change: Accept `site` (carp location) besides bbox, and match statewide `alerts/active?area=LA` rows to sites by point or zone; an empty result returns the check time so 'no active alerts' is citable as a fetch.
Accept a carp site name or lid as the place filter.
Accept the carp presets (all sites 31.1, -91.1, zoom 7.5; Atchafalaya 30.35, -91.55, zoom 8.5) and a replay flag that switches the timeline to knowledge time.
Report usgs, nwps, nws and iem for the carp app.
